Resolves #19422

🌿 The ledger no longer forbids the one credential the operator was asked to give.

ADR 0038 §2.5.1 row 1 now declares the operator's one PAT as both the fleet-surface credential (class 1) and the shell's MC credential. That follows the operator's 2026-10-06 ruling on neomjs/neo-agent-institution#571 (option d). As with row 3's seat PAT, the reuse is declared and never silent. The bearer's class, as the plane's own admission verdict reports it, is the declaration; equal bytes are not. Plane mints and the bootstrap/healthcheck PAT still refuse. §4 records the two mints the ruling rejected. This is the ledger half of neomjs/neo-agent-brain#896, which is blocked by this PR and in turn unblocks the shell's carrier (neomjs/neo-agent-institution#571).

Evidence: L1 (docs-only) → L1 required (all three ACs are decision text).

Decision Record impact: amends ADR 0038 §2.5.1 (row 1) and §4. Slot rationale: the ADR is a decision record, not turn- or skill-loaded. Row 1 is edited in place and §4 gains one dated block, the same shape as #19389.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | Row 1's Audience cell names the shell's MC use in a forge-PAT attach. Its non-alias cell declares the reuse and names the declaration: the `authSource` verdict, read back on `/fleet/probe`. It keeps three refusals: plane mints, the bootstrap/healthcheck PAT, and equal bytes with no declared class. |
| AC-2 | §4's new block "From neomjs/neo-agent-institution#571" rejects the plane-minted MC credential and the plane-minted fleet credential, each with its reason. The second is kept as the fallback. |
| AC-3 | The Amended header carries the 2026-10-06 entry. The diff touches only that entry, row 1 and §4 (1 file, +7 −2). |

## Deltas from ticket

None substantive. `learn/agentos/FleetManagerArchitecture.md` teaches the ledger with this ADR as its authority and never states row 1's non-alias cell, so it stays unchanged.
